task.description:
Two jobs after the review of step 11 and the fix of step 12.

Job 1, tests for the new guard in tools/src/picker/public/app.js changeLanguage(): a language change begun on the result screen is dropped when the visitor left the screen (Back or Start again) before the answer came — decisions/0078 item 11, design rule L4. Add tests next to QP-9j in tools/test/picker-page.test.js (use the existing helpers; independent oracles; failure-path style: check unchanged state):
 (a) the late questionnaire answer carries ANOTHER version: screen stays where Back/Start again put it, language stays the old one, address, document language, storage content and storage write log unchanged, no notice card, no new questionnaire request, header buttons keep aria-current on the old language;
 (b) the late answer is a failure (status 500 and a network error): same unchanged state AND no connection block under the header;
 (c) both for Back and for Start again if the page allows both.
Then apply on a copy outside the project the mutant "remove the new guard line" and confirm (a) and (b) fail on it; also confirm the same-version case still behaves as before. Report the kill result.

Job 2, documentation fix (finding R1 of step 11) in docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md: sections 16 and 17 must match the tests that exist: counts (62 QP in picker-page.test.js, 23 QM in picker-page-model.test.js, 12 QS), remove the name QP-11e if no such test exists, list the added tests (QP-0a, 0b, 2j, 5a2, 7g, 9f2, 9i, 9j and your new ones, QM-2e, 4d, 6a, 6b), and record the two deviations (QP-11d tested as two cards because a notice never appears together with Continue; QM-1e reinterpreted because "1e3" is refused by design, mutant M25). In rules L1 and L4 add one sentence: when a change began on the result screen and the visitor left it, leaving the screen wins over a new version and over a failure. Write new text in English; add no more English inside Russian table cells than the single sentence needed.

Rules: change only tools/test/picker-page.test.js (and picker-page-helpers.js only if a helper is missing) and docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md. Do not change code in src/. If a test shows another page defect, leave it red and report it. No git checkout/reset/stash/clean, no commits. Run npm run check once at the end from tools/ (nothing in parallel; 16 GB RAM computer). Report honestly with numbers. No machine paths and no other projects' names in the handoff text.
